implementation_revision: Commit containing this audit; normalized source identity follows verification
summary: Native nonfinancial shadow exits now receive a frozen versioned original exit context rather than a reduced object that discarded lane, proved selected subprofile and original mode. Original supplied rank participates in shadow profile selection; a later global mode or price-drawdown configuration cannot retune that saved sample. Original v4 subprofile proof is checked without changing the original predictor vector. The configured PAPER price-drawdown policy can follow uncapped extreme tails, while LIVE-mode shadows cannot enable that PAPER-only policy. First-partial realized prefix and remaining fraction supply explicitly gross whole-sample return to diagnostic protections, not remaining-token spot return or fabricated net cash. Native exit phase/adverse-excursion updates are checkpointed for retry/restart. Existing saved states or queued openings with no original context retain their old generation instead of gaining post-hoc source inputs. The simulation deliberately remains one fractional partial without quantities, fills, fees or financial multi-sale claims. A separately reproduced native exit-policy float(None) exception is repaired by preserving an explicitly nullable default; old finite values and numeric defaults remain unchanged. No buying threshold, 0.1 SOL sizing, financial transaction, operator fit/activation, history rewrite or operational run is added. Full-strategy provider/financial/profitability acceptance remains incomplete; operational processes stay off.

reproduction.original_six: Six failing native cases: birth-probe and green lane exits differ from the actual direct policy; original proved deep-reversal selection is absent; global mode leaks into an existing sample; realized gross partial prefix is missing from protection input; native exit-state changes are lost across restart
reproduction.nullable_exit_default: Eight native failures and six passing controls reproduce the actual exit-policy converter calling float(None). A real profile-resolution probe also hits this exception before reaching rank evaluation
reproduction.rank_after_nullable_repair: One native failure: original supplied rank50 is ignored, selecting jackpot_runner instead of the existing policy's broad_runner at min rank61. This is a shadow profile/context defect, not measured real opportunity loss
reproduction.historical_causality: Not established as the previous operator no-buy cause or measured financial-loss cause

contract.original_inputs: Whitelist scalar strategy inputs and original supplied rank; selected subprofile only from matching original v4 receipt, never a reason, arbitrary raw alias or outcome
contract.mode_and_policy: Capture original bool mode and configured price-drawdown snapshot before provider await; immutable state context includes exact version, role and single-partial contract. Disabled and enabled snapshots are checked; a LIVE mode cannot carry enabled PAPER policy
contract.original_features: Original predictor vector, T0, missingness and all three proof attrs remain untouched and separate from exit context
contract.gross_wealth: 100 * (original realized_pnl_ratio + remaining_fraction * current price return); unknown entry/current price remains unknown. This has no quotes, costs, token quantities or validated net profitability
contract.partial_scope: At most the original single fractional partial, with its original durable event identity; do not fabricate token quantities or invoke financial multi-partial machinery
contract.dynamic_state: Only native peak, adverse-excursion and phase updates may enter state; original context is immutable under existing generation/CAS ownership. Failed state persistence does not publish a close and is retried
contract.legacy: No context reconstruction for existing context-absent states or legacy queued openings. Preserve their original reduced simulation generation
contract.numeric_exit_default: Explicit default None now returns None for absent, invalid or nonfinite numeric values, rather than raising TypeError. Genuine finite zero and existing numeric-default behavior are retained

repository_collection.scope: Collection, not execution or financial acceptance

acceptance.native_cases: Actual admission/IO handler, current exit policy, owned state/checkpoint/restore and close outbox; temporary research paths and synthetic prices only. Cases cover distinct lane exits, original proved subprofile, rank-based profile, original mode, gross prefix, failed state IO, immutable context, invalid roles/quantity injection, legacy and uncapped price tails
acceptance.extreme_cases: Actual nonfinancial shadow tick follows +500%, +5000% and +1000000% peaks, survives 5% peak-price retrace and closes beyond the original20% price drawdown even after restart and global reconfiguration. No real token, profitable trade or market opportunity is established
acceptance.qa_harness_repair: The initial added configuration tests attempted to assign frozen dataclass fields and produced five failures plus five teardown errors. They now replace temporary configuration objects through monkeypatch; no operator configuration is edited
acceptance.scope: Source and software integration only; not full process authenticity, provider response/asof, LIVE wallet/finality, full financial ladder or prospective strategy acceptance

remaining_boundaries: No retrospective shadow or synthetic extreme path establishes profitable capture, maximum gains or full-strategy net profitability
Nonfinancial shadows remain intentionally separate from costed primary PAPER/financial multi-partial receipts; their gross return is not accepted as validated net evidence
Fresh real provider/PAPER/model acceptance requires separate authority and has not been run here
The older c771 Windows RPC birth-input mismatch remains causally unresolved; later green tests are not its explanation
Original full-process/input availability, source authenticity and independent whole-strategy capital/finality boundaries remain incomplete
